fusions.name: Curl of the Horn
fusions.desc: A butting cut that deals 14 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises +6% for every 10% of your health already gone (max +30%).

fusions.name: Nothing Inedible
fusions.desc: Sweeps a full circle that deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. It ignores armour, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Hold the Ledge
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Footing Found
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a shield worth 10% of your maximum health covers you for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
